title: NASA electrostatics scientist Charles Buehler: effect works in vacuum

tellings.quote: electrostatics. And he's saying that no this is it works. It works in a vacuum.

plain: A NASA scientist who studies electrostatics, Charles Buhler, is said to insist that a propulsion effect based on electric charge is real, and that "it works in a vacuum." That matters because working in empty space would rule out the usual explanation that such a push comes from the surrounding air. Michels relays Buhler's position himself rather than quoting Buhler directly.
